item.title: Serious fox issue because of bins, 11th August
item.description:
The communal bins within the Pasley estate are out of control. There are no lids so people from all over are dumping stuff there - there was even a bath tub, it’s ridiculous! Because of the state of them, the foxes are out of control. Every evening they scream so loud and keep the whole estate up - I have videos of the noises. I’ve only been in my flat for a few weeks and I’m already outraged and exhausted about this issue because it’s affected my sleep and mental health so much. It’s a simple fix but requires bins with lids and stricter controls.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Pasley Close, Elephant and Castle, Greater London
